title: PHP Conference Odawara 2024
content:
PHP Conference Odawara will be held for the first time in 2024.

Inspired by the enthusiasm of PHP conferences held in Japan, we have decided to host an event in "Odawara" with the aim of creating the same enthusiasm. Our aim is to liven up the PHP community even more, with the help of Odawara's appeals. This conference would get you hyped to "learn" even more!🏯🥷🍥♨️ (This conference will be conducted in Japanese)


For more information, see the event page: . PHP Conference Odawara 2024

Follow us on . 𝕏

Basic information
  • Date: April 13, 2024(JST)
  • Location: Odawara Civic Exchange Center "UMECO", Kanagawa Prefecture, Japan
